title: Senior Full-Stack / Platform Engineer (Stealth Healthcare AI Startup)
description:
Who we are

We're a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup reinventing how medical practices capture revenue. Backed by experienced founders and already live with our first client, we're building AI-driven tools that automate clinical documentation, coding, and billing — helping clinics recover revenue and improve care.

We're looking for an engineer to help build our core platform end-to-end: backend services, data flows, infrastructure, and modern frontends. You’ll work directly with founders to shape architecture, ship features fast, and turn complex healthcare workflows into intuitive products.


What you'll do

  • Build and evolve full-stack platform components (backend, pipelines, frontend)
  • Develop AI-driven features for clinical and financial data
  • Architect scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS
  • Implement clean, observable data flows for ML/LLMs
  • Ship features from 0→1 and influence product direction


Must-have Skills

  • Strong programming skills (any modern language)
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
  • Experience building platform or product from scratch
  • SQL + data modeling
  • Experience with streaming, queues, or event-driven systems
  • Startup mindset: autonomy, speed, ownership


Nice-to-haves

  • Go or Python
  • Clean architecture / DDD
  • AI/ML or LLM pipeline experience
  • Healthcare tech (EHR, RCM)
  • HIPAA / PHI security
  • HL7/FHIR/X12


Why join us

  • Build meaningful, mission-critical healthcare AI
  • Work with a small, high-caliber founding team
  • Competitive comp + meaningful ownership
  • Flexible, modern work environment


If you're excited about leveraging AI to solve complex healthcare challenges and building technology that makes a real difference for providers and patients, we want to hear from you!

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a \"big picture\" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a \"big picture\" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Analista de suporte e implantação de software
description:
Estamos contratando: Suporte / Implantador de Sistema Hablla


Você é apaixonado(a) por automação, integrações e criação de fluxos inteligentes? Já trabalhou com n8n, Make ou Zapier e adora transformar complexidade em simplicidade?


Então essa vaga é para você


Na Hablla, somos pioneiros em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI), metodologia que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Performance em uma única plataforma conversacional. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas B2B a crescerem de forma integrada, inteligente e escalável.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Implantar e configurar fluxos diretamente na plataforma Hablla, utilizando toda sua experiência prévia em automações.

Criar integrações via APIs REST e requisições HTTP, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance.

Manipular e transformar JSON em diferentes cenários de integração.

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

Customizar cadências e jornadas de atendimento alinhadas à nossa metodologia MCI.

Colaborar com os times de Customer Success e Produto, trazendo insights para evolução contínua da plataforma.


O que esperamos de você


Experiência prática com plataformas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier ou similares).

Conhecimento sólido em requisições HTTP e consumo de APIs REST.

Domínio em JSON para manipulação de dados.

Capacidade de diagnóstico e solução de problemas em integrações.

Boa comunicação, clareza e organização no dia a dia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:


Noções de Node.js ou javascript.

Conhecimento de Webhooks e mensageria em tempo real.

Vivência em implantação de SaaS B2B, CRM ou soluções Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos


Contrato PJ

R$ 4.500,00 nos 3 primeiros meses (período de experiência)

Após experiência: R$ 6.000,00 mensais

Oportunidade de crescer em uma startup inovadora, referência em tecnologia e Marketing Conversacional.


Se você se identificou, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está transformando a forma como negócios se comunicam, envie seu perfil e venha construir o futuro da comunicação com a gente!

Estamos contratando: Suporte / Implantador de Sistema Hablla


Você é apaixonado(a) por automação, integrações e criação de fluxos inteligentes? Já trabalhou com n8n, Make ou Zapier e adora transformar complexidade em simplicidade?


Então essa vaga é para você


Na Hablla, somos pioneiros em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI), metodologia que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Performance em uma única plataforma conversacional. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas B2B a crescerem de forma integrada, inteligente e escalável.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Implantar e configurar fluxos diretamente na plataforma Hablla, utilizando toda sua experiência prévia em automações.

Criar integrações via APIs REST e requisições HTTP, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance.

Manipular e transformar JSON em diferentes cenários de integração.

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

Customizar cadências e jornadas de atendimento alinhadas à nossa metodologia MCI.

Colaborar com os times de Customer Success e Produto, trazendo insights para evolução contínua da plataforma.


O que esperamos de você


Experiência prática com plataformas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier ou similares).

Conhecimento sólido em requisições HTTP e consumo de APIs REST.

Domínio em JSON para manipulação de dados.

Capacidade de diagnóstico e solução de problemas em integrações.

Boa comunicação, clareza e organização no dia a dia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:


Noções de Node.js ou javascript.

Conhecimento de Webhooks e mensageria em tempo real.

Vivência em implantação de SaaS B2B, CRM ou soluções Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos


Contrato PJ

R$ 4.500,00 nos 3 primeiros meses (período de experiência)

Após experiência: R$ 6.000,00 mensais

Oportunidade de crescer em uma startup inovadora, referência em tecnologia e Marketing Conversacional.


Se você se identificou, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está transformando a forma como negócios se comunicam, envie seu perfil e venha construir o futuro da comunicação com a gente!

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Pizzaiolo
description:
Vaga: Pizzaiolo

Local: Pizzaria Cabanas – Campo Grande, MS

Descrição da função:

Responsável pelo preparo das massas, montagem e finalização das pizzas conforme os padrões da casa. Deve garantir a qualidade, apresentação e agilidade no preparo dos pedidos, respeitando normas de higiene e segurança alimentar.

Habilidades necessárias:

  • Experiência com forno industrial.
  • Conhecimento em massas artesanais e montagem de pizzas.
  • Organização e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Agilidade, atenção aos detalhes e trabalho em equipe.

Diferenciais:

  • Criatividade para novas receitas e sabores.
  • Experiência anterior em pizzarias tradicionais ou delivery.
  • Curso na área de gastronomia ou panificação.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software (Back-End) Pleno - Afirmativa PCD
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
  • Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
  • Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de:
  • API Rest;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;
  • Teoria e prática em qualidade de dados (Dimensões, Profiling, Data Quality Assessment);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Go;
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em schedulers (Crontab, Jenkins, Airflow, etc);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (SNS, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery, ElasticSearch

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
  • Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
  • Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de:
  • API Rest;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;
  • Teoria e prática em qualidade de dados (Dimensões, Profiling, Data Quality Assessment);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Go;
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em schedulers (Crontab, Jenkins, Airflow, etc);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (SNS, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery, ElasticSearch

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based, fast paced growing startup within the Salesforce ecosystem. Our platform allows for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation, all with no coding required. We are looking to hire Customer Success Managers to join our growing Customer Success team in North America.


As a Customer Success Manager , you'll manage client onboarding, expansions, and renewals while leveraging technical expertise with a strategic business mindset to build strong customer relationships and identify growth opportunities. Join our innovative CS team to drive success and collaborate with Sales, Product, Solutions, and Support teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and adoption.
  • Lead discovery meetings with key users and stakeholders from customers and partners to position Titan as a core system and focus on maximizing its value.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive engagement and long-term success.
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning product capabilities with customer needs.
  • Analyze customer usage data to proactively address risks and drive retention strategies.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address issues to drive customer satisfaction and retention.


Requirements:

  • 2-4 years of proven experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a SaaS company (must ).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer-facing abilities, including a willingness to meet clients onsite and lead business discussions.
  • Experience in identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and working closely with Sales.
  • Hands-on experience with onboarding and implementation processes of Salesforce or other CRMs - a must.
  • A can-do approach with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work remotely across EST/PST time zones.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business or equivalent experience.


Why Join TITAN?:

  • Work with a dynamic and innovative team in a fast-growing SaaS startup
  • Collaborate with industry-leading clients and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and a healthy work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation package and opportunities for professional growth and development

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.


Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in MSP operations, or contingent workforce management .
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with Beeline
  • Bilingual Competency across English and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.


Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.


Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in MSP operations, or contingent workforce management .
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with Beeline
  • Bilingual Competency across English and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.


Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

title: Adobe Experience Asset Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Adobe Assets SME who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


* HTML, JavaScript, and CSS

* Adobe AEM Assets Management;

* Adobe’s AEM Cloud;

* Adobe Creative Cloud;

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field

An in-depth understanding of the capabilities and features of Adobe AEM Assets

Experience with Adobe’s AEM Cloud and/or on-premise solutions

Expertise in implement integration between Adobe Cloud Assets and Workfront

Ability to integrate Brand Portal with Adobe Cloud Assets

Ability to define implement metadata schemas for Adobe Cloud Assets Tags

Ability to implement review, approval process for assets to publish

Ability to integrate Adobe Creative Cloud with Workfront and Adobe Cloud Assets

* Ability to write migration utility or leverage ACS Tools to migrate assets from various source platform to Adobe Cloud Assets

* Have a good understanding of software engineering practices, SDLC

* Design, develop, and implement AEM Assets solutions in accordance with customer requirements.

* Create and maintain AEM Assets architecture and design documents.

Adobe AEM, Adobe Assets, Adobe Creative Cloud


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: .Net AWS Developer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior .NET Developer with AWS experience to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .


Working hours: Pacific Time Zone . You will be required to follow the client's time zone.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Responsibilities :

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using .NET in an AWS environment, and related technologies.
  • Develop and maintain back-end applications using ASP.NET, Web APIs, etc.
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs into internal applications
  • Ensure high-quality code by writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and adhering to best practices


Requirements:

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • Strong understanding of .NET Core and Web APIs , along with knowledge of AWS.
  • Proficient in C#, with experience building backend services (.NET framework)
  • Hands on experience in AWS environments (Azure is a plus)
  • The client expects the developer to have a very good understanding of AWS features and tools such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, EKS, Kubernetes , etc.
  • Experience supporting an integration and transformation platforms between internal systems and external vendor systems, especially those involving complex business logic.
  • Azure : Having knowledge in this area would be a bonus
  • Understanding of the QSR (fast food) industry : This is also considered a plus.
  • Good Understanding of OAuth and webhooks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience of working in a Agile environment

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Commerce Cloud - Hybris
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações baseadas em SAP Commerce Cloud, incluindo customizações de backoffice, storefront e APIs.
  • Garantir a qualidade de código e aderência às boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID, Design Patterns).
  • Contribuir em revisões técnicas, code reviews e definição de padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis e do planejamento técnico das entregas.


Requisitos

  • Experiência em SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris).
  • Conhecimento em REST APIs, OCC, Microservices e Integrações SAP.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, Oracle, HANA).
  • Uso de Git
  • Experiência com processos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Diferenciais

  • Certificação SAP Commerce Cloud Developer.
  • Conhecimento em SAP Customer Data Cloud e SAP Sales/Service Cloud.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos omnichannel ou B2B/B2C

title: Assessor de Investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Assessor(a) de Investimentos para atuar de forma estratégica na construção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com nossos clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras personalizadas e alinhadas aos objetivos de curto, médio e longo prazo de cada cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Onboarding (1º mês)
  • Um mês de imersão para você conhecer em profundidade nossos processos, ferramentas, cultura, soluções e a rotina estratégica do assessor na EQI.
  • Afinamento Comercial (2º mês)
  • Aqui você entra em um treinamento intensivo de vendas, prospecção e qualificação, aprendendo a gerar grandes oportunidades de negócio.
  • Captação e Estruturação (3º e 4º meses)
  • Além de seguir prospectando, você inicia a captação de recursos e a estruturação de carteiras, adquirindo experiência prática e recebendo, ao final, uma base de clientes para gestão e relacionamento.
  • Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com investidores de alta renda em todo o Brasil;
  • Manter ótimo relacionamento com clientes através de visitas e contatos recorrentes;
  • Estar constantemente atualizado sobre cenário macroeconômico, bem como oportunidades de mercado e produtos financeiros;
  • Assessorar e acompanhar constantemente a carteira de investimentos do cliente com foco em seus objetivos;
  • Saber gerenciar seu funil de vendas no CRM, com foco em levantar forecast e redução de ciclo comercial para atingimento de metas.



O que importa no nosso processo seletivo?

• Fit Cultural;

• Certificação CPA-20, CEA ou CFP;

• Conhecimento sobre Investimentos (RV, RF, Fundos, entre outros);

• Perfil comercial e relacional;

• Disponibilidade em tempo integral (100% presencial);

• Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).


Por que escolher a EQI?

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado
  • Suporte e acompanhamento integral das lideranças no dia a dia
  • Feedbacks estruturados
  • Sistemas avançados e tecnologias de ponta
  • Plataformas próprias de desenvolvimento profissional (EaD) com mais de 350 treinamentos disponíveis (habilidades técnicas e comportamentais)
  • Partnership

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Somos mais do que um software financeiro.


A Kamino é a plataforma de gestão financeira mais completa para empresas de serviços de médio porte no Brasil . Nosso grande diferencial está em unir um software que automatiza operações financeiras (contas a pagar, contas a receber e conciliação) à integração nativa de contas bancárias e cartão corporativo de crédito, tudo em uma única plataforma. Além disso, conecta-se de forma fluida aos principais bancos e ERPs locais .


O resultado é mais eficiência, controle e visibilidade , gerando economias significativas de tempo e custos para os clientes da Kamino.


Sobre o desafio


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Full Stack Developer para se juntar ao nosso time de tecnologia na Kamino e ajudar a construir as soluções que sustentam o crescimento dos nossos produtos.


Você busca um ambiente no qual fará parte de inovações desde o #Dia1 ?

Quer ter opções de ações e fazer parte de uma startup bem capitalizada que está pronta para acelerar?

Se a resposta for sim , continue acompanhando os requisitos que fazem sentido para essa oportunidade.


️ O que esperamos de você nesta kaminhada:


  • Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora para atuar no nosso time de engenharia, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento de produtos robustos, escaláveis e de alta qualidade. Aqui na Kamino, você terá liberdade e autonomia para propor soluções, colaborar com diferentes áreas e evoluir sua carreira com protagonismo.

title: Technical Lead Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Technical Lead Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

kills: B2B domain expertise, Salesforce, strong communication, process improvement

JD:

  • Act as the primary SPOC , coordinating resources and managing priorities across teams.
  • Drive service reviews, escalate issues, and ensure timely resolution for critical business processes.
  • Suggest and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and governance.
  • Analyze KPIs and reporting metrics to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align technology solutions with business objectives and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Expertise in Salesforce Configurations using Workflows, Process builders, Flows, Roles, Enterprise Territory Management, Security Controls, Reports and Dashboards and Sharing rules.
  • Experience in Administration, Configuration, Implementation and experience with Salesforce platform.
  • Experience in Salesforce Customization, Security Access, Workflow Approvals, Data Validation, data utilities.
  • Expertise in SFDC Development using Apex Language, Visual Force pages, Classes, Controllers, Triggers, Indexes, Web Services, Components, Tabs, Apex Web services, Custom Objects, Reports, Analytic Snapshots and Dashboards, Profiles, Creating Roles, Page Layouts, Org - Wide default, Sharing rules, Work Flows
  • Experience in Sales Cloud, Field Service and CPQ, Ant Migration tool, Standard and custom controllers, Data Loader, Force.com, Eclipse IDE Plug-in, VS Code, Work Flow-Approval, Custom objects, Custom tabs, Email service, Html, Web-service (REST and SOAP)
  • Experience in debugging the code for troubleshooting the issues


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

description:
A Exadel está procurando um Desenvolvedor Fullstack de Nível Intermediário (Java + Angular+ Quarkus) . Este profissional contribuirá tanto nas tarefas de desenvolvimento back-end quanto front-end, enquanto também desempenha um papel na garantia da qualidade do produto por meio de testes e validação. O foco será na entrega de recursos robustos, validação de integrações FIX, construção de interfaces de usuário e suporte a testes automatizados, tudo em estreita colaboração com a equipe sênior.


Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e manter aplicações usando Java + Quarkus no back-end e Angular no front-end. Experiência prática com Java 11+ e Quarkus (RESTEasy, Panache, MicroProfile). Conhecimento sólido de Angular para desenvolvimento front-end. Experiência básica a intermediária com o protocolo FIX. Familiaridade com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.

title: Angular Developer- Realocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are you going to do?

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot and microservices architecture ;
  • Participate in end-to-end implementation projects , from requirements analysis to deployment and support;
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and scalability in cloud-based environments;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical solutions and best practices;
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, testing, and monitoring tools;
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the modernization of the technology stack.


What are we looking for?

  • Strong expertise in Angular (Components, Services, RxJS, Observables, NgRx or equivalent state management tools).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3/Sass , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs and micro-frontend architectures is a plus.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma, Jest, Cypress).
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows (Git, Docker, etc.).
  • Fluent English (mandatory) — both spoken and written;
  • Available and interested in realocation to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Pleno ou Senior com forte atuação em Fiori/UI5 e Webdynpro ABAP para desenvolvimento de novas soluções e evolutivos em ambiente SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.

A atuação é voltada a projetos de desenvolvimento (novos produtos, novas funcionalidades e melhorias estruturadas), com foco em qualidade de código, performance e boa experiência do usuário.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver novas aplicações SAP Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP, incluindo definição e implementação de serviços OData e CDS Views.
  • Importante dominar FIori (freestile)
  • Implementar programas, APIs e objetos ABAP (BAPIs, BADIs, user-exits/enhancements) necessários para suportar novas soluções Fiori e Webdynpro.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Pleno, com foco em desenvolvimento (novos projetos e evolutivos), e não apenas suporte/sustentação.
  • Experiência prática com SAP Fiori/UI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, SAPUI5) e consumo/criação de serviços OData.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações Webdynpro ABAP (criação e evolução de componentes, views e controllers).
  • Vaga CLT


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: SAP BTP CAP/RAP
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP com sólida experiência em extensões na SAP BTP, utilizando CAP e RAP, para atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções cloud nativas integradas a ambientes SAP (ECC/S/4HANA).

Vaga hibrida qualquer cidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações e extensões na SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Implementar APIs, serviços OData/REST, lógica de negócio e integrações com sistemas SAP on-premise e cloud.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de aplicações existentes, realizando correções, melhorias e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos).
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento utilizando CAP (Node.js/Java) e RAP (ABAP RESTful).
  • Bom domínio de ABAP OO, modelos de dados SAP, CDS Views, OData e conceitos de clean core.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de desenvolvimento moderno (code review, testes, pipelines básicos).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa comunicação em times distribuídos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Certificações SAP em BTP, CAP, RAP ou S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5, integrações com APIs externas e eventos (Event Mesh, Kafka, etc.).


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
